activities.activity: Sleeping under warm bedding with the air conditioner set to a comfortable overnight temperature
Waking up, using the toilet and taking a quick warm shower to start the cold morning
Preparing and eating breakfast, boiling water in the kettle and toasting bread
Dressing in warm layers for the cold snap, checking the phone for shift updates and packing a bag for work
Commuting to the health care facility for the day shift
Working as a health care professional, attending to patients and completing morning clinical duties
Taking a lunch break and eating a packed meal in the staff area
Continuing clinical work, updating patient records and handing over tasks to colleagues
Cooking and eating a warm dinner, using the induction cooker and oven
Washing dishes and cleaning the kitchen surfaces after dinner
Sorting laundry and running the washing machine, then moving clothes to the dryer
Relaxing on the sofa watching TV with the space heater on, and browsing on the computer
Taking a warm evening shower and completing night hygiene routines
Reading quietly under the desk lamp and setting the air conditioner for the cold night
